name: Friendship Streaks
description: Daily mutual streaks with your friends. Both of you have to write every day to keep the shared flame alive.

server-url.name: Server URL
server-url.description: Base URL of your friendship streak server, for example https://streaks.example.com. See the README for the one-file server included with this mod.

show-badge.name: Show flame in main menu
show-badge.description: Show the flame button with your best active streak in the main menu.

show-counter.name: Show day counter
show-counter.description: Show the number of days next to the flame in the main menu.

show-flame-in-friends.name: Show flames next to friends
show-flame-in-friends.description: Show each friend's streak next to their name in the friends list, messages and on their profile.

notifications.name: Streak notifications
notifications.description: Show a notification when a streak grows, breaks, or when a friend is waiting for your reply. Special messages appear at 7, 14, 30, 50 and 100 days.

milestone-effects.name: Milestone effects
milestone-effects.description: Play a small flame burst when you reach a milestone day.
